checks.command: {python} -c "import yaml,pathlib;d=yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert d.get('jobs'), 'no jobs defined';steps=[s for j in d['jobs'].values() for s in j.get('steps',[])];runs=' '.join(s.get('run','') for s in steps);assert 'ruff' in runs or 'ci_check' in runs, 'no lint/format/ci_check step found';assert 'pytest' in runs or 'ci_check' in runs, 'no pytest step found';assert 'require-hashes' in runs, 'dependency install does not use --require-hashes';print('ci.yml structurally valid')"
